findings.title: Food handler training
findings.comment:
Inspector was unable to verify the food handler certification for the employee present. PIC assured inspector that the certificate will be acquired. Ensure that employee acquire their food handler certificate after 30 days of employment.

410 ILCS 625/3.06(b). Food handler training: restaurants. (b) Unless otherwise provided, all food handlers employed by a restaurant, other than someone holding a food service sanitation manager certificate, must receive or obtain American National Standards Institute-accredited training in basic safe food handling principles within 30 days after employment and every 3 years thereafter. Notwithstanding the provisions of Section 3.05 of this Act, food handlers employed in nursing homes, licensed day care homes and facilities, hospitals, schools, and long-term care facilities must renew their training every 3 years. There is no limit to how many times an employee may take the training. The training indicated in subsections (e) and (f) of this Section is transferable between employers, but not individuals. The training indicated in subsections (c) and (d) of this Section is not transferable between individuals or employers. Proof that a food handler has been trained must be available upon reasonable request by a State or local health department inspector and may be provided electronically.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Inspector observed that the upright cooler felt warm when opened. Upon taking IR temepratures, inspector determined temperatures of all items in the upright to be held at room temperatures (approximately 58 to 76 degrees F). Due to temperature abuse, TCS foods were immediately ordered to be discarded. Foods discarded include a bag of raw hamburger meat at 56 degrees F, bulser balls cooked on 7/6/2023 which were 73 degrees F, ranch dressing at 76 degrees F and honey mayo at 74 degrees F. Operator immediately discarded the foods as instructed. Per operator, a kid has been in the truck messing with equipment and operator has been unable to keep the kid out. A lock has been purchased. Temperature of the cooler is being monitored and appears to be functioning at this time. Ensure that temperatures remain below 41 degrees for all TCS foods at all times of operation. Corrected on site. No follow-up required at this time. 

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Test strips were not available during operations. Chemical sanitizer had already been made using quaternary ammonium tablets. Concentration of the sanitizer is approximately 200 ppm per inspector test strips. Test strips were obtained by operator from attached restaurant. Corrected on site. No follow-up required. Ensure that test strips are always available when food preparation is occurring to test the concentration of sanitizer being used in the facility.

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent.

(REPEAT) Observed multiple flies in mobile unit. Ensure air curtain is placed at openings to the mobile unit to deter flies from entering. Acceptable to place sticky fly strips away from food-contact surfaces. PIC shut back door to truck (screen door utilized). COS. This is a repeat violation since the last inspection on 9/10/21.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED.

Observed employees to wash hands improperly, no barrier used to turn off faucets after appropriate handwashing. Discussed with employees. Cross contamination issues.

Provided educational on appropriate handwashing technique and glove use. Change gloves between tasks and wash hands correctly before donning new gloves. COS.
